Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "fix: preserve symlinks in temporary repository copies" matches the main change. The PR adds copyRepository, which recreates symlinks as literal link text instead of following them, and replaces biutils.CopyDir in switchToTempWorkingDir. The objectives confirm this addresses issue `#1533`, where a tracked symlink was committed as a regular file.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#1533` requires that tracked symlinks, such as docs/index.md, stay 120000 symlinks in dependency-fix pull requests. The root cause is biutils.CopyDir in switchToTempWorkingDir, which copied symlink targets as regular files. This PR replaces that call with the package-local copyRepository (scanrepository/scanrepository.go). copyRepository (scanrepository/copy.go) walks the source tree with filepath.WalkDir. For symlink entries (entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink), it calls os.Readlink and recreates the link with os.Symlink using the literal target. Regular files still use biutils.CopyFile. Directory entries are recreated with MkdirAll. This covers directory links, absolute links and dangling links. Automated tests in scanrepository/copy_test.go cover these link types, file content and executable mode. TestSwitchToTempWorkingDirPreservesTrackedSymlink checks the temp working directory path with a Git-tracked docs/index.md link and asserts Git reports docs/index.md as Unmodified in the copied worktree. The PR author reports that the two regression tests fail on the previous implementation. I did not run the tests. The code evidence supports the required behavior.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The PR changes three files. scanrepository/copy.go adds copyRepository, which is the implementation required by `#1533`. scanrepository/copy_test.go adds regression tests for that implementation. scanrepository/scanrepository.go replaces biutils.CopyDir with copyRepository and removes the now-unused biutils import. Each change connects directly to the symlink-preservation objective. The PR description contains no unrelated work. Limitation: I did not search the whole repository for other copy paths that could also convert symlinks. That search was not needed to judge scope of the changes in this PR.
